intro: Skhug is a vibrant Yemeni green herb and chili sauce that brings bold, spicy flavor to your CAVA bowl or pita. This zesty dressing combines fresh cilantro with green chilies, creating an authentic Middle Eastern condiment that elevates any meal. Available as a complimentary dressing option on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings), Skhug delivers 80 calories of pure flavor intensity.
priceCalories: Skhug is included free with your order, allowing up to 2 dressings at no extra charge. At just 80 calories per serving, this flavorful dressing adds minimal calories while maximizing taste. With 9g of fat, 1g of carbs, and 0g of protein, it provides a light yet impactful finishing touch to your customized [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) creation.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Skhug apart is its authentic Yemeni heritage and vibrant green color from fresh cilantro and green chilies. Unlike creamy dressings, this herb-forward sauce delivers clean, bold heat without heaviness. The unique combination of herbs and spices creates a complex flavor profile that is both refreshing and fiery, making it a standout choice on the [full CAVA menu](/). Its traditional preparation honors centuries-old Middle Eastern culinary traditions.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Skhug contains 80 calories with a macronutrient breakdown of 9g fat, 1g carbohydrates, and 0g protein. The fat content comes primarily from oil used to preserve the fresh herbs and chilies. With only 1g of carbs, it is an excellent low-carb option for those monitoring their intake. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how Skhug fits your dietary goals.
whatsInside: Skhug features a simple yet powerful ingredient list centered on fresh cilantro, green chilies, and traditional Yemeni spices. The bright green color comes from the abundance of fresh herbs blended into this authentic sauce. Quality oil binds the ingredients together while preserving the vibrant flavors. This dressing contains no protein-based ingredients, making it suitable for various dietary preferences available on the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu).
tasteLike: Skhug delivers an immediate burst of fresh cilantro flavor followed by a building, pleasant heat from green chilies. The taste is herbaceous and bright with a clean, sharp spiciness that awakens the palate. Unlike vinegar-based dressings, it has an oil-smooth texture that coats ingredients evenly. The heat level is moderate to high, providing authentic spice enthusiasts with the kick they crave while remaining balanced enough for adventurous eaters.
customize: Pair Skhug with cooling [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) options like Tzatziki to balance its heat. Combine it with Lemon Herb Tahini for a layered flavor experience, using your two included dressings wisely. Add it to bowls with grilled proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) to create complex flavor combinations. Start with a smaller amount if you are heat-sensitive, then add more to taste.
pairsWell: Skhug pairs exceptionally well with grilled chicken, falafel, or spicy lamb meatballs, complementing their savory profiles. It cuts through rich ingredients like hummus and creates balance with fresh vegetables from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings). The herbaceous heat works beautifully with grain bases like brown rice or black lentils. For a complete meal, try it on [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) options for authentic Middle Eastern flavor.
healthyChoice: At 80 calories, Skhug is a relatively light dressing option that delivers maximum flavor with minimal caloric impact. With just 1g of carbs and no protein, it works well for low-carb and keto-friendly meal plans. The fresh herb base provides natural plant compounds without heavy cream or excess sugar. Its bold flavor means a little goes a long way, helping you create satisfying meals while managing portion sizes effectively.
howToOrder: When building your bowl or pita at CAVA, select Skhug as one of your two included dressings during the final customization step. Request it on the side if you prefer controlling the amount yourself. Specify your preferred spice level to staff, as they can adjust the quantity accordingly. You can add Skhug to any item on the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) or combine it with other dressings for complex flavor layering.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Greek Vinaigrette at 130 calories, Skhug offers more heat and herbaceous flavor with fewer calories. Hot Harissa Vinaigrette matches its 70-80 calorie range but provides a different, more smoky spice profile. Lemon Herb Tahini at 70 calories offers creaminess that Skhug does not, while Garlic Dressing at 180 calories is significantly richer. Skhug stands out for those seeking authentic, fresh, cilantro-forward heat without heaviness.
whoShouldTry: Skhug is perfect for spice enthusiasts who appreciate authentic Middle Eastern flavors and fresh herb intensity. Those following low-carb or keto diets will appreciate its minimal carbohydrate content. Adventurous eaters looking to explore traditional Yemeni cuisine should make this a priority. If you enjoy cilantro and crave clean, bright heat rather than smoky spice, Skhug delivers exactly what you are seeking in a memorable dressing experience.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking authentic, bold flavors at CAVA. Skhug offers a genuine taste of Yemeni culinary tradition that you will not find at typical Mediterranean restaurants. At 80 calories and included free with your meal, there is no financial or dietary risk in experimenting. The fresh, herbaceous heat adds restaurant-quality complexity to any bowl or pita, transforming simple ingredients into an extraordinary dining experience.

faqs.a: Skhug has a moderate to high spice level with building heat from green chilies. The fresh cilantro provides herbaceous flavor that balances the spiciness. If you are sensitive to heat, start with a small amount and add more as desired, or pair it with cooling options like Tzatziki to moderate the intensity.

faqs.q: Is Skhug included free at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Skhug is included free as one of your two complimentary dressings with any bowl or pita order. You can select up to two dressings at no additional charge, making it an excellent value option. There is no extra cost to add Skhug to your customized CAVA meal.

Skhug tastes bright and herbaceous with strong fresh cilantro flavor followed by pleasant green chili heat. The flavor profile is clean and sharp rather than smoky or vinegary. It has an oil-based texture that coats ingredients smoothly, delivering authentic Yemeni spice with every bite without overwhelming other flavors in your bowl.

Skhug is naturally gluten-free, made from cilantro, green chilies, and oil without wheat-based ingredients. However, always verify current preparation methods with staff or check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for the most accurate allergen information. Cross-contamination is possible in shared preparation areas, so inform staff of any severe allergies.

faqs.q: Can I get extra Skhug at CAVA?
faqs.a: You can request additional Skhug beyond your two included dressings, though extra portions may incur an additional charge. Many locations offer dressings on the side for better portion control. Ask your CAVA team member about adding extra Skhug when ordering, or visit [CAVA Locations](/locations) to contact your nearest restaurant about their policies.
